video_summary.overall_goal: Navigate audiobook collection and control playback
video_summary.description: User starts playing an audiobook (Alice's Adventures in Wonderland), interacts with playback controls in expanded UI mode, accesses menu, browses book collection, and switches to different audiobook (Hamlet)

steps.what_screen_is_visible: Dark audiobook player screen showing Alice's Adventures in Wonderland with a large green play button in the center. Minimal UI (only play button visible).
visible_ui_elements: Book title: Alice's Adventures in Wonderland
steps.system_response: Audio playback initiates. UI expands to show additional controls.
steps.navigation_change: Stays on player screen, UI mode transitions
steps.visual_feedback: Play button changes state; expanded control UI appears

steps.what_screen_is_visible: Expanded playback control interface with volume controls (speaker icons), forward/backward skip buttons (blue arrows), rewind time buttons (30s, 1m circles), and red stop button (large square in center).
visible_ui_elements: Volume control icons (yellow speakers at top)
Rewind buttons (30s and 1m timers in circles)
steps.system_response: Audio playback stops. Controls remain visible.
steps.visual_feedback: Red stop button highlights on tap; audio playback ceases

steps.what_screen_is_visible: Menu screen appears with list of options (scrollable). Menu items visible include settings, playback options, library navigation, and system menu items. Dark theme with light text.
steps.system_response: Menu screen slides into view from bottom or replaces player UI.
steps.navigation_change: Transition from player to menu screen
steps.visual_feedback: Menu fades/slides in with visible list of options

steps.what_screen_is_visible: Same menu screen, user scrolls through available menu items. Multiple options visible including playback settings, library options, and system preferences.
visible_ui_elements: Multiple menu items with icons (gears, folders, sliders)
steps.system_response: Menu scrolls to reveal additional options below.
steps.visual_feedback: List scrolls; new items appear at bottom, items disappear at top
steps.intent_task: Browse menu options to find desired setting or action

steps.what_screen_is_visible: Player returns to main audiobook player screen, now showing different audiobook title 'Hamlet'. Green play button visible (same layout as step 1, different book).
steps.target_element: Back button or menu close action
steps.system_response: Menu closes, returns to player screen showing new audiobook (Hamlet instead of Alice's Adventures).
steps.navigation_change: Menu → Player screen; book changed in collection
steps.visual_feedback: Menu fades out; player screen appears with new title displayed
steps.intent_task: Return from menu to main player; user has selected new audiobook to play

overall_flow: User opens audiobook player with Alice's Adventures in Wonderland (stopped state)
Taps play button to start audio; expanded control UI appears
Taps stop button to pause playback
Accesses menu (likely from expanded UI or back button)
Returns to player; audiobook changed to Hamlet
human_readable_step_summary: Step 1: The audiobook player opens showing Alice's Adventures in Wonderland with a large green play button.
Step 2: User taps the play button. Audiobook starts and expanded controls appear (volume, skip, rewind, and stop buttons).
Step 3: User taps the red stop button. Audio playback stops. A menu screen appears.
Step 4: User scrolls through the menu to browse available options.
Step 5: User returns from menu to the player. A different audiobook (Hamlet) is now selected and ready to play.
